format: new Traditional Unit (freestanding Taco Bell restaurant; In-Line/End-Cap units cost $934,750 to $1,817,200 with a $25,000 fee)

invest.quote: The initial investment necessary to begin operation of a new Traditional Unit is from $1,859,750 to $4,312,200 including $45,000 that must be paid to the franchisor and for the first unit only, $27,250 that must be paid to an affiliate.

fee.quote: We charge an initial franchise fee of $45,000 for a new Traditional Unit.  The initial franchise fee for a new In-Line or End-Cap is $25,000.
fee.note: During fiscal year 2025, the initial franchise fees paid ranged from $0 to $45,000 per Unit. Fee may be waived under the National Incentive Program (Traditional Units with drive-thrus), Urban Test Incentive Program (In-Lines) and De-Coupling Incentive Program. Existing franchisees in the 10K Trade Areas program pay a $10,000 Trade Area Fee credited to the initial fee. Successor fee: greater of $22,500 or 1/2 of then-current initial fee.

royalty.quote: Period Franchise Fee (Note B)(ii) (Note C) 5.5% of the Unit's Gross Sales On or before the 5th business day immediately following the accounting period in which the sales were made

adFund.quote: Period Marketing Fee (Note B)(ii) (Note C) 4.25% of the Unit's Gross Sales On or before the 5th business day immediately following the accounting period in which sales were made
adFund.note: Paid to the Taco Bell National Advertising Fund Administration (NAFA). Existing franchisees who did not accept the 2012 marketing provisions pay 4.5% of gross sales, of which 1.5% is allocated to local store marketing. Incentive programs can waive marketing fees for 1 to 4 years or reduce them to 2.25% for the first year. Grand opening spend of $5,000 is reimbursed (up to $5,000) for new units.

item19.quote: Each third-party forecast vendor used their forecast tools to project 2nd year sales of 183 existing Units opened between January 1, 2023 and December 31, 2023 with at least 2 years' worth of Gross Sales data. ... Kalibrate ... Projected annual Gross Sales of the sample single brand Units ranged from $826,707 to $3,621,383
item19.note: With the limited exception of use of the Bell Point, Kalibrate, and Site Zeus forecast tools that are available to all franchisees developing free-standing, drive-thru Units, as described below, we do not make any representations about future financial performance or the past financial performance of any company-owned or franchise Units. Figures are projections (not actual sales), sales only, no costs; sample excludes multi-brand, in-line and licensed Units.

special: In 2025 the franchisor reacquired 144 franchised Units (102 in Florida, 23 in Georgia, 19 in South Carolina), hence franchised -6 and company-owned +165. For the first Unit, a Development Services Agreement with affiliate YRSG may be required at $25,000 plus $2,250 ADA inspection; optional YRSG real estate services $10,000. Item 7 includes purchased land ($250,000 - $1,400,000); ground lease base rent may range from $45,000 to $200,000 or more per year. Existing restaurants bought from Taco Bell may be leased/subleased from it at rent 'generally ranges from $1,331.00 to $20,833.00 per month' (fixed, not % of sales). Purchases mainly through RSCS / Taco Bell Co-op purchasing program. Liquidated damages on certain terminations: greater of 11% of the Unit's Gross Sales for last 12 months or $100,000.
issues: Item 19 gives only forecast-tool back-test ranges, no average or median actual sales. Item 20 Table 1 total 2025 start (7839) does not match 2024 end (7847). toFranchisor computed from cover ($45,000 franchisor + $27,250 affiliate, first unit); Item 7 also counts optional YRSG real estate services $10,000-$37,250.
